item.title: SLS Sydney Roster Is Locked In
item.description: The SLS Sydney roster is locked in and it's stacked from top to bottom. As we kick off the 2026 season, expect a mix of brand new faces, established legends, and rising stars all ready to battle it out in Sydney. Day 1: Knockout Rounds is your chance to see every skater compete. Day 2: Finals, plus the best trick jam. It’s almost here. February 14-15.

item.title: One Week Until SLS Sydney❗️
item.description: What are you waiting for? You’ve got one week to secure your tickets to SLS Sydney. Two full days of high-energy skateboarding to kick off the 2026 season. Day 1 is your chance to see every skater battle it out in the Knockout Rounds. Day 2 brings the Finals plus the best trick jam. We’ve got a sick course and the best skateboarders in the game. Don’t miss it February 14 and 15 at Ken Rosewall Arena. Get your tickets now.
